title: Tear film thickness and stability following femtosecond-assisted laser in situ keratomileusis: a comparison of high- and low-myopia

indication: low myopia and high myopia groups defined by the preoperative refraction (inclusion: spherical error 0 to −3.00 D or more than −6.00 D, astigmatism within the stated limit); one (right) eye per patient

groups.description: Low-myopia group (LMG): spherical equivalent '≤−3.00 D' as printed (inclusion: spherical error 0 to −3.00 D); FS-LASIK with Ziemer FEMTO LDV Z2 flap and Schwind AMARIS 500 ablation; single surgeon

High-myopia group (HMG): spherical equivalent '≥−6.00 D' as printed (inclusion: spherical error more than −6.00 D); FS-LASIK with Ziemer FEMTO LDV Z2 flap and Schwind AMARIS 500 ablation; single surgeon

exclusions.what: Table 3 SEQ row (1 and 3 months by group)
exclusions.reason: postoperative values without the preoperative reference; same visits as Table 2 (duplicate eyes)

exclusions.what: Table 1 SEQ row (preoperative by group and total)
exclusions.reason: preoperative only; the whole-cohort column would duplicate the subgroups; the Table 2 preoperative cell of each group is used as its reference

notes: Groups are defined by the preoperative degree of myopia (patient-condition subgroups), both control; only the subgroups are tabulated over time, so no whole-cohort series is extracted.
Target refraction is not stated in the article; recorded as unstated.
Refraction method: 'spherical equivalent refraction (SEQ)' is listed first in the examination order without stating manifest, cycloplegic or objective; recorded as unstated.
Table 1 prints a preoperative SEQ for the LMG that differs from the Table 2 preoperative cell; the Table 2 cell (same table as the follow-ups) is cited.
If both eyes met the criteria the right eye was selected; one eye per patient.
Table 2 also tabulates UDVA, CDVA, lipid layer, tear meniscus, break-up times, Schirmer, OSDI, staining, epithelial and tear film thickness (not extracted; schema 1.0.0 has no such series).

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 2 footnote); postoperative cells carry the table's significance markers (* or #) after the value; per-visit n not reported (header N = 26)
